name: Food delivery support inbox
description: Customer messages to a food delivery app. Laya triages each one: what went wrong, how upset the customer is, whether they want money back, and whether there is a health or safety risk that must go to a human immediately.

issue.instructions: What is the main problem the customer is reporting?

criteria.late_delivery: the order arrived late or has not arrived yet
criteria.wrong_item: the customer received a different dish than they ordered
criteria.missing_item: part of the order was not in the bag
criteria.payment_problem: charged twice, wrong amount, card or promo code issue
criteria.compliment: the customer is happy and giving praise

wants_refund.instructions: Does the customer ask for a refund, credit, or their money back?

safety_risk.instructions: Does the message mention a health or safety risk, such as an allergic reaction, food poisoning, or a foreign object in the food?

cases.state: My order was supposed to arrive at 7:30 and it's now 8:45. Still nothing, and the driver isn't answering. This is ridiculous, I want my money back.
I ordered the vegetarian pad thai but got chicken pad thai instead. I'm vegetarian so I can't eat this. Can you send the right one?
The garlic bread and one of the two drinks weren't in the bag. Please credit my account for the missing items.
I clearly wrote NO PEANUTS in the notes because of my son's allergy. The curry had peanuts and he broke out in hives. We're at the urgent care now.
I was charged $42.10 twice for the same order #88213. Please fix this.
Just wanted to say the driver was super friendly and the food was still hot. Best burger I've had in months, thank you!
Found a piece of plastic in my salad. Absolutely disgusting. Never ordering from you people again.
